lede: Wat Nam Dip accounts for 7 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Lampang (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1865–1960 CE (4 of 7 carry a date).
